entries.summary: Clipboard bridge wakes Wine's clipboard window every 0.5 s: Wine 11.0 acquire_selection() lacks XFlush, so LINE copies never reached the host and host pastes bounced back as stale LINE content
Clipboard reads stream through read_capped and kill xclip once LIMIT is exceeded, instead of buffering the whole selection before checking the cap

Frame window (lib/frame.py) embeds Xephyr via -parent: title-bar close minimizes, keyboard focus is handed to Xephyr, frame fixed at 1280x800 because Wine stretches the fullscreen LINE window after a nested resize

next: Make LINE follow a resized frame: after a nested RandR change Wine 11.0 stretches the fullscreen LINE window or caps its height (see docs/architecture.md, 改大小的限制)
